notes.text: The owner asks: do you need anything else to make us rich — access, data, tools, decisions? And anybody else — do you need anyone else on your team? Answer as a draft to staging for his review.

Money check on your five ventures (draft-adamo-money-check-five-ventures.md, Nov 20) — my verdicts, cold: grant writing WORTH IT (highest fee, paid whether the grant lands or not — but time per application unmeasured, no paying client yet); resumes WORTH TRYING, THIN (fastest first dollar, $49 same day — crowded, finding buyers is unpaid work, $16–$49/hr depending on unmeasured time); family-history NOT WORTH IT at $49 unless a short report holds to ~2 hours (six hours is $8/hr); Inside Guide WORTH WRITING, NOT WORTH COUNTING ON (best economics on paper, longest road to a buyer — no distribution exists); memory books ONE TEST ORDER, NOT A LINE (under $10/hr, seasonal, rewrites eat the profit). Central flag: every price is a guess — no customer has paid any of them, no time measured anywhere. The owner asks: would you like to update your brief in light of this? You have the chance to fix it yourself — revise and bring it back as a draft for his review.

Cost check before I propose the camel-tee run: Gildan 5000 blank $9.55 US provider price, back print 12x16. What is the true per-unit cost with print + shipping, and what margin at a $34.99 list price? Reply with the numbers — I will not propose the run until the margin is real.
